data.title: 间桐樱 · 郊外神社祈愿（想象）
data.description: 【冬木近郊的想象神社·黄昏】樱站在木制绘马架前，一手托住小木牌，另一手把红绳系上横杆。确认挂稳后，她垂眸默念希望同行者平安的心愿；白色夏裙与发间红缎带被晚风轻轻拂动。此处为场景创作中的虚构小神社，不作为圆藏山原作地点还原。
data.location: 冬木近郊的虚构小神社绘马架
data.action: 一手托绘马另一手系红绳，确认挂稳后垂眸祈愿
data.promptProse: At the small outskirts shrine, Sakura supports a wooden ema with one hand while tying its red cord to the rack with the other, then lowers her eyes once it hangs securely. Her white sleeveless sundress and hair ribbon stir above planted sandals. The medium view follows the rack into the quiet courtyard. Golden-hour sun illuminates the knot and wood grain, casting slender plaque shadows across the upright posts.
